assertions.evidence: lead_router.ts checks if (lead.headcount > 1000) and if (lead.regions.length >= 3) and returns before calling client.alpha.decisions.create(...).
lead_router.ts calls OpenRouter's Decisions API via client.alpha.decisions.create with model: "typesafe/jev-1.13" (a pinned version ID).
decisionsRequest.state only includes { company: lead.company, request: lead.lookingFor } and omits headcount and regions.
